title: Icon Coverage, Light Mode Fixes & UI Polish
headline: Process Manager and Debloat now recognise far more apps with correct logos, light mode loading spinners and active nav indicators are fixed, the startup score ring is cleaner, and the Apply Recommended button has been removed.
changes: Expanded Process Manager icon coverage — Firefox now shows the correct flame logo, SwitchControl, StreamDeck, Node.js, Qt processes, TranslucentTB, and dozens more now resolve proper brand icons
Expanded Debloat installed-apps icon coverage — Git, Python, PostgreSQL, Node.js, qBittorrent, FlyByWire Simulations, REX Game Studios, Qt Company, and more now display correct logos
Fixed icon lookup bug where 3-character publisher keys (amd, msi, hp, obs) were silently skipped in prefix matching — now correctly matched
Fixed light mode: loading spinners (Rescan, sync, etc.) were frozen due to the global animation-duration kill catching animate-spin — now correctly exempted
Fixed light mode: active sidebar nav item lost its visible ring outline — inline box-shadow was stripped; replaced with Tailwind ring class which survives the light-mode kill
Removed decorative track ring from the Startup boot score gauge — value arc now floats cleanly on the dark background
Removed Apply Recommended button, its premium gate, lock badge, backend route, and all associated dead code
